mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Yield curve inverts (10y-2y < 0) during the signal period, indicating a looming recession that will negate the positive earnings impulse.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production, indicating supply chain disruptions, will lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as companies struggle to meet demand and profits are squeezed.
failure_condition: SPX returns are positive in > 50% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: Rising unemployment, measured by the monthly change in UNRATE, signals a weakening labor market and slowing consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE rises by > 0.5pp over 3 months, but SPX returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, indicating a restrictive monetary policy, S&P 500 returns will be negative over the next 20 trading days as higher borrowing costs weigh on corporate profits and consumer spending.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5% for 3 consecutive months, but SPX returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) rise by more than 10% year-over-year, signaling a strong housing market, consumer confidence and spending will increase, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST rises > 15% YoY, but SPX returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.1) over the next 60 trading days.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4% and falling, signaling a tight labor market, wage pressures will build and lead to higher inflation, causing the Fed to raise rates and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE falls below 3.5% and FEDFUNDS rises by > 0.5pp in the next 2 months, but SPX returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) and real sales (RSAFS) both decline by more than 2% in a month, signaling a broad-based slowdown in economic activity, S&P 500 returns will be negative over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO and RSAFS both decline by > 3% in a month, but SPX returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.1) over the next 5 trading days.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI (CPIAUCSL) rises by more than 0.5% in a month, signaling a surge in inflation, the Fed will be forced to raise rates aggressively, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL rises by > 1% in a month, but FEDFUNDS does not rise by > 0.25pp in the next month, or SPX returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).
